---
name: Bug report
about: Describe one reproducible problem using synthetic data.
---

## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduce

Source commit, OS/architecture, Node version and minimal steps. Use invented data
and redact local paths or account identifiers. Do not upload databases, raw logs,
private screenshots, model credentials or real customer files.

## Evidence

Relevant check result and a small redacted error. Distinguish source checks from
native UI, scripted model responses, real inference and live provider behavior.

Security concern? Use SECURITY.md and contact a maintainer privately.
